name: ICPR 2026 LR-LPR
description: ICPR 2026 official challenge. 23K tracks (20K train + 3K test). Train: 10K Scenario-A (5K Brazilian + 5K Mercosur) + 10K Scenario-B (2K Brazilian + 8K Mercosur). Each track: 5 LR + 5 HR frames. Total ~230K images from real-world surveillance.
resolution: LR + HR frame pairs (dimensions not published)
